name: Coffee Café at Daringbadi Coffee Garden
signature_dish: Locally grown and processed Daringbadi coffee
why_it_matters: A café set inside the government-managed Daringbadi (Kilabadi) coffee plantation — one of the oldest coffee-growing tracts in India — serving coffee grown and processed on site. It is run by the Betania women's Self Help Group, whose members were trained in coffee processing as a local-empowerment initiative, and was set up under the Kandhamal district administration. Drinking estate-grown coffee at its source is the single most distinctive food experience in the 'Kashmir of Odisha'.
insider_tip: This is the one genuinely on-brand stop in Daringbadi — taste the local coffee where it is grown, not a town café. The garden also has a children's amusement zone and a butterfly-shaped selfie point, so it works as a family halt. Pair it with the coffee-and-pepper plantation walk; carry cash.
signature_address: Coffee Garden, Kilabadi, Brahmanigaon Road, Daringbadi, Kandhamal District, Odisha 762104

name: Hotel Hilltop Restaurant
why_it_matters: The first-floor restaurant of Hotel Hilltop on Medical Road is among the most reviewed eateries in Daringbadi — roughly 3.9/5 across 640+ Google ratings — and is repeatedly named one of the best places to eat in a town with very few proper restaurants. It serves both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food and is a reliable hot-meal option for travellers in this thinly served hill station.
insider_tip: Daringbadi has limited and inconsistent restaurant options, so a hotel restaurant like this is the safer choice — and it does not require staying at the hotel. Food quality is best in peak tourist season (winter); in the off-season, order ahead as kitchens run light. Carry cash; card and UPI are unreliable here.
signature_address: Hotel Hilltop, Medical Road, near Government Hospital, Daringbadi, Kandhamal District, Odisha 762104

name: Hotel Hill View Restaurant
why_it_matters: A budget hotel-restaurant in Daringbadi town carrying around 3.8/5 across 250+ Justdial ratings. Travellers report standard, fairly priced meals — a vegetarian thali around ₹80 and a chicken plate around ₹100 — making it one of the few documented sit-down options for tourists who do not want to depend solely on their resort kitchen.
insider_tip: Best as a simple, cheap lunch stop rather than a destination meal. As with most Daringbadi kitchens, food is freshest in tourist season and during the main meal windows — turn up at standard lunch and dinner hours rather than odd times. Cash only is safest.
signature_address: Hotel Hill View, Daringbadi, Kandhamal District, Odisha 762104

name: Daringbadi Nature Camp Restaurant (OTDC / Odisha Eco-Tourism)
signature_dish: Home-style Odia veg and non-veg meals included with cottage stays
why_it_matters: The dining facility of the government Daringbadi Nature Camp, run under Odisha's eco-tourism programme amid pine forest and coffee-garden surroundings. Cottage tariffs include breakfast, lunch and dinner, and the kitchen serves both vegetarian and non-vegetarian home-style Odia meals — effectively the in-house dining for one of the most popular places to stay at this hill station.
insider_tip: Meals are geared to camp residents and run on fixed sittings, so this is for travellers booked into the Nature Camp rather than walk-in diners — confirm meal timings at check-in. Book the cottage well ahead in winter season, as the camp fills quickly. Tariffs already bundle all three meals.
signature_address: Daringbadi Nature Camp, Daringbadi, Kandhamal District, Odisha 762104
